Hymn 15: I Saw a Mighty Angel Fly
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Leroy J. Robertson
Lyricist/Text Author: George Manwaring
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 15 titled "I Saw a Mighty Angel Fly" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Leroy J. Robertson and the lyrics were written by George Manwaring.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
